role: ground / stall / icon model of the Fuel Tank gear item (the worn tank the Flamethrower burns from)
approval: task-specific user generation grant 63caa2a0-d8b5-44c0-9b69-fa4eb22585e2 (a scoped cap of 75 Meshy credits); this model: 15 credits, the first attempt of its design image
route: Codex native image_gen INITIAL design image (a front elevation of the outward side: the jerrycan on its frame) -> Meshy T2.5 image-to-3D (smart topology, 2K PBR); the Meshy model keeps its own PBR maps (re-encoded only)

conditioningImage.generator: Codex CLI built-in image_gen (ChatGPT login); image model id not reported
conditioningImage.note: the INITIAL design image (kept outside Git): a reference only, not an input of this cook

meshy.evidence: the exact create arguments, the charge, the price evidence and the raw hash are in the job ledger kept outside Git

source.kind: the Meshy raw original: kept outside Git, read-only and never shipped
source.axes: the jerrycan (the outward side) facing +Z, +Y up, the shoulder straps looping out toward -Z

weld.rule: exact-attribute weld (bitwise-equal position / normal / uv), degenerate triangles and unreferenced vertices dropped: lossless

processing.simplify: none: the model's triangle count is kept
processing.rotation: rotateY(180deg): (x, y, z) -> (-x, y, -z); raw +Z (the jerrycan, the outward side) -> -Z, the gear derivatives' front

orientationCheck.rule: above the waist belt (y 0.3 .. 0.62 m) the shoulder straps reach z >= 0.15 m behind the frame (the wearer's side) and the jerrycan stands out no farther than z = -0.14 m in front

processing.heightRule: uniform scale so the overall Y extent (the hanging waist belt's buckle to the top of the frame) = 0.62 m: a pack frame the height of a torso, carrying a slim jerrycan
processing.origin: grounded (min y = 0) and centred on x / z; baked into the vertices

frame.rule: the largest island lying inside the box min [-0.15,0.04,-0.05] max [0.15,0.6201,-0.015] (m)

jerrycan.rule: the largest island lying inside the box min [-0.125,0.125,-0.105] max [0.125,0.55,-0.02] (m)

textures.note: Meshy's 2048 px map downsized to 1024 (sharp lanczos3, JPEG q86 4:2:0)
Meshy's 2048 px map downsized to 512 (sharp lanczos3, JPEG q88 4:4:4)
Meshy's 2048 px map downsized to 1024 (sharp lanczos3, JPEG q90 4:4:4)

texturePolicy: the model's own PBR maps kept slot for slot (base colour / metallic-roughness / normal), downsized 2048 -> 1024 / 512 / 1024 px and re-encoded (no recolour, tint, re-texture, projection or new art)
limitations: one rigid mesh: the straps, the waist belt, the pump lever and the hose are modelled in place and do not move

the waist belt is modelled as a closed loop hanging around the foot of the frame: its buckle is the model's lowest part, so the standing pack rests on the belt and the frame's feet stay 51 mm above the floor
the jerrycan is modelled slim (a shallow can against the frame's back plate)
convention: metres at real size, +Y up, front -Z (the jerrycan side; gear/models.ts turns gear derivatives to +Z), grounded, centred on x / z
licence: generated for this project under the existing provider accounts; unapproved prototype asset, no blanket licence or commercial clearance implied (assets/CREDITS.md)
